extName.message: FocusFence – Website Blocker & Pomodoro Focus Timer

extDescription.message: Block distracting websites in one click, or just YouTube Shorts. Schedules, Pomodoro focus timer and strict mode. 100% private.

strictBannerOn.message: Strict mode is on. Your blocklist can only grow.

strictBannerUntil.message: Strict mode is on until $1. Your blocklist can only grow.

blocklistDesc.message: Blocking a domain also blocks its subdomains — {code}reddit.com{/code} covers {code}old.reddit.com{/code} and {code}m.reddit.com{/code}.

hintDomain.message: Blocks the whole site, including every subdomain.

hintPath.message: Blocks only that section. youtube.com stays reachable; youtube.com/shorts/… is blocked. Query strings (?…) are not used.

hintKeyword.message: Blocks any page whose address contains this word.

accessTextOne.message: 1 site is blocked with Chrome's error page because FocusFence hasn't been given access yet. Allow access to see the calm block page and count stats.

accessTextOther.message: $1 sites are blocked with Chrome's error page because FocusFence hasn't been given access yet. Allow access to see the calm block page and count stats.

accessKwTitle.message: Keyword rules use Chrome’s error page

accessKwText.message: Keywords can appear on any site, so showing the block page for them needs access to all sites. Optional — blocking works either way.

emptyText.message: Start with the sites you open without thinking — social feeds, news, video.

entryErrorPageTitle.message: FocusFence can't show its block page here yet. Chrome's error page is shown instead.

removeStrictTitle.message: Strict mode: sites cannot be removed

toastAccessGranted.message: Access granted — the block page is on

scheduleDesc.message: Only block during the hours you want to focus. Outside these windows, blocking pauses automatically.

windowsEmpty.message: No time ranges yet. Add one, e.g. weekdays 09:00 – 17:00.

focusDesc.message: Pomodoro-style rounds. During focus, everything on your blocklist is blocked — even outside your schedule.

strictDesc.message: For when willpower runs out. While strict mode is on, blocking can't be turned off, sites can't be removed and the schedule can't be changed. Ending early takes a 10-minute cooling-off period and a typing challenge.

incogText.message: FocusFence isn't allowed in Incognito, so a private window skips your blocklist — even in strict mode. Turn on {em}Allow in Incognito{/em} in FocusFence's extension details.

strictStaysOn.message: Stays on until you unlock it

strictPaused.message: Paused for $1 while FocusFence was not running — the end time moved accordingly.

strictNeedOut.message: Need out? Request an unlock. You'll have to wait 10 minutes, then type a sentence exactly.

coolingText.message: Still want to unlock? Take a breath. You can cancel anytime.

challengeIntro.message: Type this exactly to end strict mode:

limit1.message: Chrome lets you disable or remove any extension from {code}chrome://extensions{/code}. FocusFence can't block that page. A timed strict session {strong}pauses{/strong} while FocusFence is off, so its time can't run out in the background.

limit2.message: Incognito windows are only covered if you allow FocusFence in Incognito (see above).

limit3.message: Other browsers, other Chrome profiles and other devices aren't covered.

confirmStrict.message:
Start strict mode for $1?

You will not be able to turn blocking off or remove sites. Ending early takes a 10-minute wait and a typing challenge. The timer pauses while FocusFence is disabled.

confirmStrictIncognito.message: Note: Incognito windows are not covered until you allow FocusFence in Incognito.

toastGoodCall.message: Good call. Strict mode stays on.

toastNoPaste.message: Type it out — pasting is disabled.

blockpageDesc.message: Write a note to your future self. It replaces the rotating quotes on the block page.

messagePlaceholder.message: e.g. You promised yourself the thesis chapter first.

securityDesc.message: Require a password to turn blocking off, remove sites or change settings. Ideal if someone else holds the key. Passwords are hashed (PBKDF2) and never leave this device.

passwordSet.message: Password is set. Unlocked for this session.

lockText.message: Enter your FocusFence password to make changes.

backupDesc.message: Export your blocklist, schedule and preferences as JSON, or import them on another computer. Passwords and stats are never exported.

ob1Title.message: Pick 3 sites that steal your focus

ob1Text.message: Start small: pick up to three. You can add as many as you like later — Free has no limit.

obCustomPlaceholder.message: Or type another site, e.g. news.example.com

obMax.message: Three is plenty to start — add more later in Settings.

ob1Perm.message: Next, Chrome asks once to let FocusFence show its calm block page on these sites. If you say no, they are still blocked.

ob2Text.message: Chrome doesn't run extensions in Incognito windows unless you allow it. Without it, a private window skips your blocklist — even in strict mode.

ob2StatusOn.message: FocusFence is allowed in Incognito. You are covered.

ob2StatusOff.message: FocusFence is not allowed in Incognito yet.

ob2How.message: Open the extension details and turn on {strong}Allow in Incognito{/strong}. Optional, but recommended if you plan to use strict mode.
